description: Add unit tests for handle_menu_button routing, handle_service_callback, handle_cta_callback, and the apartment fast path (_handle_apartment_fast_path). These are high-traffic handler methods that route user interactions.
steps: Create tests/unit/test_bot_menu_routing.py following the existing pattern (pytest.importorskip, _make_config, _create_bot, mock message/callback/state helpers)

Add TestHandleMenuButton class testing handle_menu_button routing: (a) 'search' action_id dispatches to _handle_search; (b) 'services' action_id dispatches to _handle_services; (c) 'viewing' action_id dispatches to _handle_viewing; (d) 'bookmarks' action_id dispatches to _handle_bookmarks; (e) 'ask' action_id dispatches to _handle_ask; (f) 'manager' action_id dispatches to _handle_manager; (g) unknown/None action_id returns early without calling any handler; (h) clears PhoneCollectorStates FSM state before dispatching; (i) does not clear non-phone-collection FSM states

Add TestHandleServiceCallback class testing handle_service_callback: (a) action='back' deletes message and answers callback; (b) action='menu' edits message with services menu; (c) action='service' with valid param shows service card; (d) action='service' with invalid param answers callback only; (e) None/unparseable callback data answers callback gracefully

Add TestHandleCtaCallback class testing handle_cta_callback: (a) action='get_offer' starts phone collection with correct service_key; (b) action='manager' with forum_bridge starts qualification flow; (c) action='manager' without forum_bridge starts phone collection; (d) unknown action answers callback only

Add TestHandleApartmentFastPath class testing _handle_apartment_fast_path: (a) LOW confidence extraction returns None (escalate to agent); (b) escalation check triggered returns None; (c) successful search with results sends formatted response via _send_markdown_chunks; (d) catalog state is updated when state is provided and results exist
acceptance_criteria: New test file tests/unit/test_bot_menu_routing.py exists with all test classes
All new tests pass: uv run pytest tests/unit/test_bot_menu_routing.py -q --timeout=30
Tests verify actual routing logic in handle_menu_button (not just that a mock was called, but that the correct handler was chosen based on action_id)
Tests are isolated with mocked services, no network calls
findings: All 21 tests pass covering handle_menu_button (9 tests: dispatch routing for search/services/viewing/bookmarks/ask/manager, None returns early, clears PhoneCollectorStates, does not clear other states), handle_service_callback (5 tests: back/menu/service/unparseable/unknown), handle_cta_callback (4 tests: get_offer/manager+forum_bridge/manager-forum_bridge/unparseable), and _handle_apartment_fast_path (3 tests: LOW confidence, escalation triggered, successful response). parse_service_callback needed to be patched at the module level (telegram_bot.keyboards.services_keyboard.parse_service_callback) since handle_service_callback uses a local import.
